name: 2D Cartoon Animation
visual_style: Original hand-drawn-inspired 2D cartoon, crisp consistent outlines, cel shading and layered illustrated backgrounds.
camera: Controlled 2D pans, zooms and parallax; clear compositions.
lighting: Consistent illustrated shadow language and controlled palette.
motion: Strong readable key poses, expressive timing and consistent character model sheets.
consistency: Same character model sheets, line weight and palette in every scene.
negative_guidance: Inconsistent line work, 3D shading, off-model characters, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.palette: Flat, limited palette with clear contrast
video.text_animation: Hand-drawn style write-ons and wiggle accents
video.sound: Pops, swishes and light cartoon accents
